english: You spot an indent in the wall.
Something is there.
The goblin squints, his eyes going from the hole to you.
He nods.
With a faint tug the wall tile breaks apart, revealing a soot-covered, but otherwise intact, safe.
Right where he said it was.
That's one expensive box. Not the type you'd find in the back of a tea shop.
Let's see what the birdman's got for you...
It could contain important evidence. Force it open!
You're gonna bend solid steel? Just input the combination, come on. The birdman told you!
The safe is covered in iron studs, having been reinforced by a highly skilled blacksmith.
There's a rotating handle at the center - its position used to input the entry code.
Fine craftsmanship.
(Enter the safe's entry code.)
Of course there's a safe in the owner's office. Just makes sense.
Jackpot! Let's get this bad boy open...
You're gonna bend solid steel? Don't think so, big guy.
If you listen to the clicking noise within, you should be able to get it open...
The goblin is correct. This does not make sense.
Unless this birdman deals with something more valuable than tea leaves.
You approach the open safe.
You approach the safe.
Attempt to get it open.
E-I should ignore the safe, for now.
You whisper the magic word. An old Diminorian term that would be translated into something like, 'Full Access'.
You rotate the handle around while pressing your ear against the cold iron.
You listen to the tiny clicks within, stopping the rotation when you do.
Your companion quietly watches with an intrigued expression on his face.
The goblin is surprised and impressed.
After several careful turns of the handle, you hear a satisfying thump from inside the safe.
You rotate the handle around in the correct positions.
Your fingers fumble about the handle.
After several rotations you hear a tiny click from inside.
Oh. You did it! That's the correct rotation!
(Pull the handle.)
A sharp pain spreads through your hand.
Instinctively you pull back.
Out of the handle you see a tiny blade. It would have pierced through your hand if you hadn't moved away in time.
You see a tiny blade sticking out of the handle.
No wait, not just the handle.
The blade is currently sticking through your hand.
You carefully remove your now bleeding hand from the blade.
Leaking. Beware.
Do not allow piercing of this kind.
Oh, shut up.
It's a clean cut. You're barely bleeding.
What's going on? You okay, Cle-
Snell stops and stares at your hand.
It's a clean cut. Not that bad. (Keep bleeding on the floor.)
Uh... oh boy.
You'll live. The pain is temporary.
The bird trapped his damn safe? That's diabolical.
It means he has things he truly wants to keep secret.
Well now you know the safe is trapped. So, you know, it'll be easier next time.
Next... time?
E-Leave the safe. For now.
And...
The safe opens with a metallic scraping noise.
A layer of soot falls off as the contents are revealed to you.
Yes! Well done!
Well done, Cleric. Now let's see what we got...
You glance inside. The fire certainly did not reach anything here.
(Grab the coins.)
(Grab the strange rocks.)
(Grab the exotic container.)
(Grab the spell scroll.)
You grab the pouch and add the 101 crowns to your collection.
You pocket them all.
You grab it. It contains some type of mushroom dust.
A form of light mago-drugs. Not even illegal. But expensive.
Nice. Snort it!
It is not drugs.
It is magical enhancements.
Drugs would not be allowed at the Towers. No Cleric can take such substances.
But this? It's not good for you, no, but it could be useful - and more importantly, you are allowed it.
The birdman was into some dank stuff. This'll keep you alert a bit longer.
Nasty sludge. Enjoy it, Cleric.
You grab the scroll.
It contains the spell 'Detect Poison and Disease' which has very specific use-cases. You will most likely not need it.
The birdman must've had it around to check bad tea, I guess?
The owner must have been very paranoid to keep this around.
Unless you've got nefarious enemies, there's no point in keeping a spell like this around.
Interesting. This guy seriously thinks someone's going after him.
And technically we are, but this was before the explosion.
You look at the paper.
A single, very long sentence is written on it.
REMINDER: THE THIRD TILE TO THE LEFT BEHIND PAINTING IF IT DOESN'T WORK FIRST TIME TRY THREE MORE TIMES AND THE SECRET HIDDEN PASSAGE WILL OPEN -Myself
Wow.
(Glance towards the burnt picture frame on your right.)
Yep. You can open that secret passage now.
The goblin stares at the paper.
Right. Secret door. Got it.
And just gotta say: this nefarious shit Drummer was doing here? It's a miracle we didn't catch it sooner.
